Aspiring television professional Mohini encounters Bollywood actor RK. Following an initially hostile introduction, the pair navigate a complex relationship involving romance and betrayal.

Aai Tulija Bhavani strives to overcome multiple challenges and defeat the evil powers, in order to protect humanity and maintain peace.
